g.text: Vary S: compare where D-majority gives way to C-majority
Bars: differences between sampled crossing brackets, NOT confidence intervals. Arrows: conditional one-sided bounds.
Symbols above panels: × multiple/reversed crossings; ○ no comparable bracket. No binary search or fitted thresholds.
Matched valid choices and beliefs; at most four decisions/cell. Exact utility ties permit either action.
